steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease two 9x5-inch loaf pans.

In a large bowl, cream together shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Stir in eggs one at a time, beating well with each addition. Stir in mayonnaise and bananas. Stir together flour, salt, baking powder, and baking soda. Blend flour mixture into banana mixture; stir just enough to evenly combine. Fold in chocolate chips and walnuts.

Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center of a loaf comes out clean, about 50 to 75 minutes. Cool loaves in the pans for 20 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

raw_recipe.headline: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
raw_recipe.description: This easy chocolate chip banana bread recipe makes 2 deliciously moist loaves with sweet morsels of chocolate and crunchy walnuts in every bite!

review.reviewBody: This recipe is really good - I don't normally use shortening, so I substituted butter and it came out great.

This is a great recipe. Moist and flavorful bread. I used butter instead of shortening, but only half the amount. I doubled the bananas (I had a bunch to use up anyway) to add moistness since I cut the fat, used all brown sugar and added vanilla. I remembered the mayo in one batch and forgot it in the other. The one without came out pleny moist. The batch with the mayo was good but almost too moist. I think I'll stick with the extra bananas and skip the mayo. I made muffins instead of loaves so my kids could grab and go. I love this recipe and will be making it often.

For one loaf - Used half white sugar and half brown sugar. Subbed in 1 tbs unsweetened apple sauce for the mayo. Subbed half butter and half unsweetened applesauce for the shortening. Omitted nuts. Dusted chocolate chips with a teaspoon of flour from the recipe. Added 3/4 tsp vanilla, 1/4 tsp each of cinnamon and nutmeg. Baked at 325 for 70 minutes in a buttered and then sugar sprinkled loaf pan.

Everyone loves this chocolate chip banana muffins! I like to do mini muffins (approx 8-9mins) or regular muffins (14mins) and they turn out perfect.
I like to add 1 teaspoon of vanilla, 1 tsp of cinnamon, and 1/2 tsp of nutmeg like someone else said. and I cut the sugar down to 2/3 of what the recipe calls for and it's still sweet due to the chocolate chips.
Oh, and freeze those ripe bananas! When you are ready to bake, defrost it and use all the juice and the bananas in the recipe and they turn out so moist and delicious!!

This is delicious and highly addictive! The recipe is also very forgiving. I did as others suggested and used unsalted butter instead of the shortening. I also used dark chocolate chips, and increased the amount. I accidentally started putting the bananas/mayo mixture in before the eggs, but it still worked out fine. I did a half recipe, and put them into a jumbo muffin pan (made 6 jumbo muffins). Took about 27 minutes for them to get to the perfect done-ness. Will definitely make these again!!!

First time I made it...fell in love with it. Second time I added my ideas of dried cranberries, raisins and used 2 c flour, and 1 c Teff flour. I only had 3 bananas so I added 1/2 c of fresh ground peanut butter. For sugar I used 1 c turbinado, 1/3 c molasses, 1/8 honey. Great recipe T12GR!

I have made this several times and usually in muffin form so we can have some at home and I can also share at work. Change bake time to about 20-25 mins as muffins. I do omit the nuts because I am the only one in the house that likes them. Always gets rave reviews for sure! Thank you!

Already posted that this was delicious, however after reading other comments I tweaked it a bit. I used butter instead of shortening (didn't have any), 1 cup white and 1 cup of dark brown and I dusted the chocolate chips on flour so they wouldn't sink. Makes three regular size loafs of yummyness!

Used butter instead of shortening & special dark chocolate chips, and took the suggestions of others and added vanilla & cinnamon, made muffins so grabbing on the go was much quicker...this is hands down the best banana bread (muffin) recipe! Thanks for sharing & I really do think the mayo is key!

This was delicious. Like others I substituted butter for shortening, added cinnamon and vanilla, and put them into mini muffin tins so only baked them for about 20 minutes. I will definitely make these again.

Excellent. Grease pans well!! My changes were to add a touch of cinnamon and nutmeg. Also, used butter, and a full cup of chopped walnuts, 1c. of brown in place of 1c. white. Sprinkle a bit of cinnamon sugar on top if want. Baked 60min. Loved it. I think you can change any part to your taste and this recipe would be great.
This has been my go too for years!!! Everyone raves about this banana bread! Make it! It will not disappoint👍❤️
I have made this recipe many times over the past 5-6 years. It always turns out fantastic.
My favorite b bread recipe- I only use half the amount of sugar and use half cup olive oil/half cup butter for shortening to still get butter flavor but a little healthier …

My family and friends love this. I do sub butter for the shorten and flour the walnuts and choc chips (another person reccomended this) I made small single serving loaves. Great with coffee in the morning Susan

Still in the oven but it sure smells good and the precooked mixed ingredients tasted great...LOL....and it was fun to make with the grand kids. This is similar to another recipe I use. The mayonnaise was a new ingredient for me so we are looking forward to tasting the finished product. Also seeing if using a glass pan vs metal pan makes a difference as I only had one of each.
The recipe makes two moist banana nut bread loaves. I would probably add some brown sugar and chopped nut mix to the top next time. Not crazy about adding mayo.

This is The best banana bread!
I have been using this recipe for years , either as bread or muffins, always a hit.
I substitute butter for shortening and sprinkle cinnamon sugar mix on top before baking for a little added something.
So good.
